name: My Otaku Girlfriend -Pacarku Otaku-
source:
A romance visual novel with a school vibes.

That day, a high school student expressed his feelings to the person he loved. But unfortunately, he was rejected by the girl. Not wanting to waste time, he decided to move on and forget the girl immediately. One day, a transfer girl came to his class. It turns out that she is a transfer girl from Japan. The story of the approach of these two characters begins. Curious how it goes? Let's play My Otaku Girlfriend.
